course_name: 第二語言習得專題討論
outline: 本課程將對第二語言習得的主要議題進行深入地探討論與分析。上課的內容包括，但不限於，下列主題: 語言天賦、跨語言影響、人格特質、學習動機、學習風格、學習策略、外語焦慮和外語學習信念等。
schedule:
Week 1: Orientation: Second language acquisition/learning theories
Week 2: Second language acquisition/learning theories
Week 3: Qualitative Research in Second Language Acquisition
Week 4: Quantitative Research in Second Language Acquisition
Week 5: The Linguistics of second language acquisition
Week 6: Cognitive accounts of second language acquisition
Week 7: Social aspects of second language acquisition
Week 8: Socio-cultural theory and second language acquisition
Week 9: Mid-term Exam
Week 10: Pragmatic aspects of learner English
Week 11: Affect in second language acquisition: Individual learner differences and second language acquisition
Week 12: Learning Strategies
Week 13: Input, interaction, and output
Week 14: Instructed second language learning: classroom second language acquisition
Week 15: Researching second language vocabulary
Week 16: Researching second language reading and listening
Week 17: Researching second language speaking and writing
Week 18: Final Exam
assessment:
Attendance and Participation: 30%
Oral Presentation: 40%
Final Term Paper: 30%
